div.head: Iud Dei VIII 2.4
div.ab: Do þu þonne, drihten hælend Crist, þis to loue 7 to wuldre ðinum þam halgan naman, þæt ðe oncnawon ealle men, þæt ðu eart gebletsod God, ðu ðe leofast 7 rixast mid Fæder 7 mid halgum Gaste on worulda woruld a butan ende. Amen.

Do this now, Lord Saviour Christ, to the praise and glory of your holy name, so that all people may know that you are the blessed God, who lives and reigns with the Father and with the Holy Spirit, forever and ever, without end. Amen.

Thue du nun Herr Heiland Christus, dies deinem heiligen Namen zu Lob und zu Ruhm, damit dich erkennen alle Menschen, dass du bist der gebenedeite Gott, du der lebest und herrschest mit dem Vater und mit dem Heiligen Geiste in der Ewigkeiten Ewigkeit immer ohne Ende. Amen.

Do this now, Lord Saviour Christ, to the praise and glory of your holy name, so that all men may know you, that you are the blessed God, you who live and reign with the Father and with the Holy Spirit for ever and ever, always without end. Amen.
div.note: Clause number standardised from ‘2,4’. In Ca ‘ðu’ is corrected from ‘ðe’ and ‘halgum’ from ‘halgam’.
